deviations.description: Rule C is not implemented: the network has essentially no sensitivity to cord_lim vs cord_floor, so a request whose cord goal is below the anatomically achievable cord dose is sent to automated planning whenever rules A, B and D do not apply.
deviations.condition: (cord_lim < cord_floor) and not (cov > cap) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > 0.1) and (cov > mand_lim)) and (missing == 0)
